[auth/handler] BladeAuthorizationHandler: preValidation, authValidation, authSuccessful
[auth/handler] BladeLockHandler: validateAccountLock, validateIpLock, clearLock
[auth/handler] BladePasswordHandler: matches(BCryptPasswordEncoder)
[auth/handler] BladeTokenHandler: enhance(JWT生成)
[auth/service] BladeUserDetailService: loadByUsername + UserCache
[auth/granter] CaptchaTokenGranter: grant(token发放)
Redis Key: blade:lock:fail:account:{account}
